$comment: Pins the .NET SDK band for reproducible builds across developer machines and CI. version is the floor; rollForward 'latestMinor' accepts any installed 10.x SDK at or above it (so CI's setup-dotnet '10.0.x' resolves cleanly) but will NOT silently jump to a future major (.NET 11) that could change analyzer behaviour. allowPrerelease:false keeps preview SDKs out of release builds. Bump 'version' deliberately when adopting a newer band.
